units.source_text: “有一天，正是临时祭[\[6\]](#part1331.html#m6)预演音乐的那天，夜深时分，雨雪纷飞。

en.t: One day, on the day of the rehearsal music for the temporary festival, late at night, rain and snow were swirling through the air.

units.source_text: 诸人从宫中退出，各自归家。

en.t: Everyone withdrew from the palace and went home separately.

units.source_text: 我左思右想，除了那女子的住处之外，无家可归。

en.t: I thought it over from every side, and apart from that woman's residence, I had nowhere to go home to.

units.source_text: 在宫中借宿一宵，也太乏味；

en.t: Spending the night lodged at the palace would be far too dreary;

units.source_text: 到另外那个装腔作势的女子那里去过夜，又难得温暖。

en.t: and going to spend the night with that other affected woman would hardly bring me any warmth.

units.source_text: 于是想起了那个女子，不知道她后来作何感想，不妨顺便前去一探。

en.t: So I thought of that woman, wondering how she had felt afterward, and decided I might as well stop by and see.

units.source_text: 便掸掸衣袖上的雪珠，信步前往。

en.t: I brushed the pellets of snow from my sleeves and set off at an easy pace.

units.source_text: 到了门口，又蹑手蹑脚，觉得不好意思进去。

en.t: When I reached the gate, I found myself moving on tiptoe again, too embarrassed to go in.

units.source_text: 继而一想，今宵寒夜相访，往日的怨恨大约可解除了吧，便毅然直入。

en.t: Then I thought that a visit on such a cold night might well dissolve her old resentment, and I resolutely went straight in.

units.source_text: 一看，壁间灯火微明，大熏笼上烘着些软软的厚厚的日常衣服，

en.t: Looking around, I saw a faint lamp glowing by the wall, and on the large incense-warming frame some soft, thick everyday robes were being warmed,

units.source_text: 帷屏[\[7\]](#part1331.html#m7)高高揭起，仿佛今宵正在专候。

en.t: while the curtain screen was raised high, as though she had been waiting especially for me that night.

units.source_text: 我觉得很好，心中自鸣得意。

en.t: I was pleased by this and felt inwardly quite satisfied with myself.

units.source_text: 但她本人不在，只留几个侍女管家。

en.t: But she herself was not there; only a few serving women had been left to watch the house.

units.source_text: 她们告诉我：‘小姐今晚在她父亲那里宿夜。’

en.t: They told me, 'My lady is spending the night at her father's house.'

units.source_text: 原来自从那事件发生之后，她并未吟过香艳的诗歌，也没有写过言情的书信，

en.t: It turned out that ever since that incident, she had not composed any amorous poems, nor had she written any love letters,

units.source_text: 只是默默地笼闭在家。

en.t: but had merely shut herself up at home in silence.

units.source_text: 我觉得败兴，心中想道：难道她是有意叫我疏远她才那样嫉妒的么？

en.t: I felt disappointed, and thought to myself: could she have acted so jealous on purpose, in order to make me keep my distance?

units.source_text: 然而并无确实证据，也许是由于心情不快而胡乱猜测的吧。

en.t: Yet there was no real proof; perhaps I was only guessing wildly because I was in a bad mood.

units.source_text: 向四周一看，替我预备的衣服，染色和缝纫都比以前更加讲究，

en.t: Looking around, I saw that the clothes prepared for me were more carefully dyed and sewn than before,

units.source_text: 式样比以前更加称心。

en.t: and their style pleased me even more than before.

units.source_text: 足见决绝之后，她还是忠心地为我服务。

en.t: This showed plainly that even after our break, she was still faithfully serving me.

units.source_text: 现在虽不在家，却并非全然和我绝交。

en.t: Although she was not at home now, she had not completely cut ties with me.

units.source_text: 这天晚上我终于没有见到她。

en.t: In the end, I did not see her that night.

units.source_text: 但是此后我多次向她表明心迹，她并不疏远我，

en.t: But afterward, when I repeatedly showed her what was in my heart, she did not keep me at a distance,

units.source_text: 也不躲避得使我没处寻找。

en.t: nor did she hide so thoroughly that I had nowhere to find her.

units.source_text: 她温和地对待我，绝不使我难堪。

en.t: She treated me gently and never put me in an awkward position.

units.source_text: 有一次她说：‘你倘还像从前一样浮薄，恕我不能忍受。

en.t: Once she said, 'If you are still as frivolous as before, forgive me, but I cannot bear it.

units.source_text: 你倘改过自新，安分守己，我便和你相处。’

en.t: If you mend your ways and conduct yourself properly, then I will stay with you.'

units.source_text: 我想：她话虽如此，岂肯和我决绝，我再来惩治一下吧。

en.t: I thought: even if she says that, surely she would never break with me; I will punish her once more.

units.source_text: 我不回答她今后改不改，但用盛气凌人的态度对付她。

en.t: I gave her no answer as to whether I would change in the future, but dealt with her in an overbearing manner.

units.source_text: 不料这女子大为悲伤，终于郁郁地死去了。

en.t: Unexpectedly, this woman was deeply grieved, and in the end she died in sorrow.

units.source_text: 我深深领会，此类无心的恶戏，是千万做不得的！

en.t: I came to understand deeply that this kind of thoughtless cruel game must never, under any circumstances, be played.
